name: Purdue University
tuition_note: In-state (Indiana resident) undergraduate tuition & fees $9,992 for 2025-26 (General Service $9,718 + Fitness/Wellness $234 + Activity $40), West Lafayette campus, flat rate 8+ credit hours, from purdue.edu/treasurer/finance/bursar-office/tuition/fee-rates-2025-2026/undergraduate-tuition-and-fees-2025-2026/. Housing $5,476 is room only (meals billed separately) for a Standard Double w/AC, Academic Year 2025-26, from Purdue Residences housing-rates data (housing.purdue.edu/my-housing/info/housing-rates.html room-rates.csv). Standard doubles without AC (e.g. Owen/Wiley) are $4,250.
